text: Take a new route somewhere you go every day.
reason: Even one different street changes the trip.

text: Make a wish on a dandelion.
reason: Then make a second wish, just in case.

text: Plant a seed and take a photo of it every day.
reason: Sprouts are faster than you think.

text: Find the place in town that smells the best.
reason: A bakery, a garden, a coffee roaster.

text: Arrange your books by color.
reason: Then take a photo of the shelf.

text: Make a bouquet from things that aren't flowers.
reason: Branches, herbs, tall grass.

text: Sew a patch onto something you wear.
reason: A jacket, a bag, a favorite pair of jeans.

text: Fold a paper airplane and find the best place to fly it.
reason: A hill, a park, a long hallway.

text: Take a photo of your hands at work.
reason: Kneading, knitting, fixing, writing.

text: Paint a rock and leave it somewhere for someone to find.
reason: A small surprise for whoever's next.

text: Find a piano in a public place and play one song.
reason: Chopsticks counts.

text: Count the cats sitting in windows on your street.
reason: Wave. They won't wave back.

text: Walk barefoot on grass for ten minutes.
reason: Your feet will thank you.

text: Jump in a big puddle.
reason: Boots recommended, not required.

text: Make friendship bracelets and trade them.
reason: Pick colors that remind you of each other.

text: Try a fruit you've never eaten.
reason: Persimmon, dragon fruit, starfruit, a pluot.

text: Write a letter to your future self.
reason: Seal it and write the date to open it on the front.
